title: Sundance Golf Club
gap: Prices for green fees, lessons, and rentals not stated
blurb: Sundance Golf Club offers a 9-hole executive golf course with four sets of tee boxes ranging from 5,300 to 7,000 yards. The course provides a visual experience with views of the White Tank and Estrella Mountains. The club offers individual and group golf lessons for all ages and skill levels, as well as equipment rentals including clubs and carts.
hoursText: Daily 6:00 AM to 10:00 PM, including holidays
